evidence.emitter: ARCHITECTURE §2 assigns damage-taken to Combat. Player returns undefined for Combat payloads; the normal, guard and late-parry paths emit exactly once.
evidence.outgoing: Enemy damage still emits once for blood, audio and shake; exact player identity prevents an added red lens pulse.
evidence.preserved: The committed harness observes bloodImpact and impact shake for both event directions. Independent direct Effects and Audio handler execution also preserved enemy pain audio.
evidence.eventOrder: Combat still emits hit before damage-taken for normal and late-parry contacts; guard emits damage-taken then clash.

refutations: Player and Combat do not double-emit.
Filtering the lens does not suppress enemy blood, impact shake or pain audio.
A distinct faction=player entity does not pulse the local-player lens.
Perfect parries still emit no damage feedback.
limitations: No fresh rendered/audio/device capture has passed for this change yet.
No overall game or R17 acceptance is claimed.
